title: Revive your Dyson (updated March ‘22)
text:
Revive your Dyson (updated March ‘22). The reviews are accurate - This has transformed my old Dyson DC35 from nearly unusable, almost garbage to a whole-house cleaning machine. Very impressed with the improvement. This is how the vacuum should gave operated from the factory.
***Update*** Dropped two stars. This battery was great vacuuming the whole house for about 12-14 months then the performance dropped dramatically. A few months ago it stopped charging. Tried a new charger thinking that was the issue but it wasn’t. I’m disappointed this battery had such a VERY short lifespan and needs to be replaced already.
